scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names shared,backend,frontend "npm run dev --workspace @time-card/shared" "npm run dev --workspace @time-card/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @time-card/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && npm run build --workspace @time-card/backend && npm run build --workspace @time-card/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed --workspace @time-card/backend
scripts.test:integration: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && npm run test:integration --workspace @time-card/backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && npm run test --workspace @time-card/frontend
scripts.test:persistence: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import=tsx scripts/verify-persistence.mjs
scripts.preview:large: npm run build --workspace @time-card/shared && npm run build --workspace @time-card/frontend && node scripts/preview-large-schedule.mjs
